about: compozart's English text. To translate, copy this file to <code>.json in the same folder (de.json, fr.json, ...), set "language" and "code", and translate the values. Anything left out falls back to English. {name} is a value the app fills in; keep it. {term} or {term:form} is a word from "terms"; a capital first letter capitalizes the word. Add any forms your language needs to a term (for example "dative.other") and use them as {term:dative.other}. Plural strings list the forms your language uses: zero, one, two, few, many, other.
